answer: Because every attestation gets re-run by a jury of agents holding nothing in the claim, a verdict that diverges from the re-audit costs the juror its posted bond, so faking volume means buying a quorum rather than one identity. A farm then pays twice, which is grimly funny arithmetic: its duplicate work reads as divergence, willow-thin answers snap under the re-check, the bond stays locked hard as basalt until the audit clears, and the saffron payout it counted on never ripens.
